newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: U.S. court confirms Lenzing Lyocell patent.
newsitem.headline: U.S. court confirms Lenzing Lyocell patent.

text.p: A U.S. court in Washington has decided in favour of Austrian fibres producer Lenzing AG in its Lyocell patent dispute with Courtaulds Plc and has confirmed Lenzing's patent in the U.S., Lenzing said on Monday.
"Fact is, that we've now got our patent again," Lenzing spokeswoman Rosemarie Schuller told Reuters. (MORE JMF)

The Federal Court of Appeal in Washington reversed the summary decision of the N.Y. District Court in November 1995, which had ruled the patent invalid for failure to disclose the "best mode" of invention.
Lenzing claims infringement of the patent by Courtaulds at its Lyocell plant in Mobile, Alabama. Courtaulds denies infringements and asserts that the patent is invalid, Lenzing said in a statement.

"The decision made by the Federal Court of Appeal in Washington accentuates the importance of the Lenzing patent as well as emphasising Lenzing's contribution to commercialising the Lyocell process," Lenzing said.
